concept.title: Combinators
concept.shortdesc: A combinator describes the relationship between two elements. Put the related element’s selector on the left and the element you want to match on the right.

section.title: Descendant and sibling relationships
section.p: Use a space to select a descendant at any depth. Use > for a direct child, + for the next element sibling and ~ for any later element sibling with the same parent.

The first rule selects every title inside a chapter, even when other elements are between them. The second selects only titles that are direct children of a chapter. The last two select paragraphs based on their position after a title.

section.title: Column combinator
section.p: The column combinator || relates elements that belong to the same table column.

section.title: Reference combinators
section.p: A reference combinator relates elements through an attribute that refers to an element ID.
The name between slashes is the reference attribute. CSSMedia accepts this syntax and uses the referenced element relationship when matching.
